content = open('scripts/plot_hero_figures.py').read()
# Find F4 section start
f4_start = content.index('# F4: C0 vs SICA-SC Gap')
# Find the line before it (the separator)
sep_start = content.rfind('# ====', 0, f4_start)
# Replace everything from sep_start to end
new_f4 = '''# ============================================================
# F4: C0 vs SICA-SC Gap (FIXED: superseded points removed)
# ============================================================
# Valid data points (exp-011 LLaMA-8B D012 and Qwen-14B D012 removed)
f4_data = [
    # label, C0, delta_pp, n, model, domain
    ('Qwen-14B (PW+FOLIO)', 0.3818, 0.3, 804, 'Qwen-14B', 'Logic'),
    ('LLaMA-8B FOLIO', 0.618, -2.45, 204, 'LLaMA-8B', 'Logic'),
    ('LLaMA-8B StratQA', 0.41, 2.0, 200, 'LLaMA-8B', 'Commonsense'),
    ('Mistral-7B D012', 0.5, 0.0, 60, 'Mistral-7B', 'Logic'),
    ('DS-R1-7B D012', 0.583, -3.33, 60, 'DeepSeek-R1-7B', 'Logic'),
    ('Qwen-14B ARC', 0.05, -1.67, 60, 'Qwen-14B', 'Science'),
    ('Qwen-14B StratQA', 0.1, 3.33, 60, 'Qwen-14B', 'Commonsense'),
    ('QwQ-32B PW', 0.026, -5.9, 17, 'QwQ-32B', 'Logic'),
]

f4_model_colors = {
    'Qwen-14B': CB_BLUE,
    'LLaMA-8B': CB_ORANGE,
    'Mistral-7B': CB_GREEN,
    'DeepSeek-R1-7B': CB_RED,
    'QwQ-32B': CB_PURPLE,
}
f4_domain_markers = {
    'Logic': 'o',
    'Commonsense': 's',
    'Science': '^',
}
f4_text_offsets = {
    'Qwen-14B (PW+FOLIO)': (6, 6),
    'LLaMA-8B FOLIO': (6, -10),
    'LLaMA-8B StratQA': (6, 5),
    'Mistral-7B D012': (6, -10),
    'DS-R1-7B D012': (6, 5),
    'Qwen-14B ARC': (6, 5),
    'Qwen-14B StratQA': (6, -10),
    'QwQ-32B PW': (6, 6),
}

base_size = 30
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.0))
ax.axhline(y=0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

for label, c0, delta, n, model, domain in f4_data:
    marker_size = base_size * np.sqrt(n / 60)
    p_avg = min(max((c0 + c0 + delta/100.0) / 2, 0.05), 0.95)
    se = np.sqrt(2 * p_avg * (1 - p_avg) / n) * 100
    ci = 1.96 * se
    ax.errorbar(c0, delta, yerr=ci,
                fmt='none', ecolor='#666666', elinewidth=0.8,
                capsize=2, capthick=0.6, zorder=2)
    ax.scatter(c0, delta,
               c=f4_model_colors[model],
               marker=f4_domain_markers[domain],
               s=marker_size, edgecolors='k', linewidths=0.4, zorder=3)
    dx, dy = f4_text_offsets[label]
    ax.annotate(label, (c0, delta),
                fontsize=6.5, ha='left', va='center',
                xytext=(dx, dy), textcoords='offset points',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#aaaaaa', lw=0.5))

ax.set_xlabel(r'\$C_0\$ (Multi-candidate Rate)')
ax.set_ylabel(r'\$\\Delta_{\\mathrm{pp}}\$ (SICA \$-\$ SC)')
ax.set_xlim(-0.02, 0.72)
ax.set_ylim(-9, 6)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

f4_model_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=c,
           markeredgecolor='k', markeredgewidth=0.4, markersize=7, label=m)
    for m, c in f4_model_colors.items()
]
f4_domain_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker=mk, color='w', markerfacecolor='#aaaaaa',
           markeredgecolor='k', markeredgewidth=0.4, markersize=7, label=d)
    for d, mk in f4_domain_markers.items()
]
leg1 = ax.legend(handles=f4_model_handles, loc='upper left', title='Model',
                 framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc', fontsize=7, title_fontsize=8)
ax.add_artist(leg1)
ax.legend(handles=f4_domain_handles, loc='lower right', title='Domain',
          framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc', fontsize=7, title_fontsize=8)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/f4_c0_vs_gap.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/f4_c0_vs_gap.png', dpi=300)
plt.close(fig)
print('F4 saved.')
print('Done.')
'''
new_content = content[:sep_start] + new_f4
open('scripts/plot_hero_figures.py', 'w').write(new_content)
print('plot_hero_figures.py updated')
